A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TPGDiff work and have readable text, equations, tables and figures. V1's supplementary material can be matched against content retained, relocated or omitted in v2. The supplied v2 ends after its references and contains no appendix.

before.justification: V1 reports original restoration benchmarks, component and placement ablations, qualitative comparisons, and POLED/TOLED generalization results in Appendix D.

after.justification: V2 retains the original benchmark results and reports additional prior-placement controls and structural-component ablations in Tables 6–7.

M1.justification: The semantic distillation, structural token aggregation and adapter, degradation classifier, temporal modulation, and IR-SDE restoration procedure remain unchanged. Main-text Equations 1–16 are retained. Missing appendix implementation details do not establish a changed method.

E1.justification: The nine single-task benchmarks and five-task joint setting are retained. POLED and TOLED move from v1 Appendix D into v2's main text; they are not new coverage. The new structural-component ablation reuses Rain200L and LOL-v2, already used in v1.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding single-task, joint-training and unknown-task comparisons. V1's unknown-task Table 6 becomes v2 Tables 2–3 with the same methods. 'TUR AirNet' becomes 'TUR' with the same cited work and scores; missing bibliography entries do not remove benchmark participants.

E3.justification: V2 adds controlled depth/segmentation/DoG removals on Rain200L and LOL-v2, plus two additional prior-placement configurations. Existing training budgets, metrics and prior-type ablation settings remain unchanged. Omitted dataset-split documentation does not demonstrate that the retained experiments used different splits.

E4.justification: The ablation evidence is substantially revised: v2 Table 7 and Figure 5 test individual structural cues, while Table 6 adds structural-only injection at both depths and uniform injection of both priors. Conversely, v1 Appendix D.2 and Figure 6's spatial error analysis of misplaced priors are omitted. These changes alter the mechanisms directly investigated.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or uncertainty estimates for the experimental scores. Averaging ablation metrics across tasks remains distinct from statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All matched benchmark and prior-type ablation scores are unchanged. New results include Table 6's 31.73 and 31.51 PSNR controls and Table 7's 29.46 full-model PSNR versus 29.00/29.22/28.94 without depth/segmentation/DoG. These are additional ablation findings, not improvements over v1 under matched settings. Most supplementary qualitative examples are omitted.

T1.justification: V2 omits Appendix A's supporting IR-SDE mathematics, including the coefficient constraint, Gaussian marginal expressions and score derivation, and Appendix C.1's formal layer-partition definitions. The main mathematical formulation remains unchanged, with no new theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about hierarchical triple-prior guidance, structural fidelity, semantic consistency and restoration performance. Moving unknown-task evidence into the main text does not expand the previously stated generalization claim.

C2.justification: V2 adds interpretation of the structural-component ablations and expands discussion of balancing task-specific degradation removal with shared reconstruction. V1 Appendix D.2's detailed explanation linking concentrated errors to mismatched layer representations is omitted. The unknown-task generalization interpretation is retained, and no substantive new limitations are stated.

D1.justification: V2 loses Appendix B's dataset counts and splits, including the customized NH-HAZE 49/6 split, and Appendix C's exact shallow/deep stage assignment and D=4 configuration. These are important reproducibility details for the central design and comparisons. Training hyperparameters, hardware disclosures and the project-page link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Multiple references disappear, including Retinexformer, AutoDIR and FoundIR-v2 despite their retained Table 1 rows, and the introduction's pixel-aware stable diffusion citation. The substantive positioning against existing restoration and prior-injection approaches remains largely unchanged.

P1.justification: The main/supplementary organization is substantially reworked: unknown-task evaluation moves into Section 4.2, most supplementary sections disappear, and structural-component discussion, an Impact Statement and Acknowledgements are added. Existing method prose receives limited grammatical and terminology edits, alongside author-year citation formatting and revised front matter.

P2.justification: V2 adopts a different conference layout, expands Figure 1, redesigns Figure 4 with enlarged crops and ground truth, and adds structural-cue Figure 5. V1's combined unknown-task table becomes two main-text tables. The layer-partition table, placement-error figure and most supplementary image galleries disappear; ablation tables are expanded or added.

improvement.justification: V2's additional placement controls and structural-cue ablations strengthen evidence for important design choices. However, losing explicit layer boundaries, dataset splits and supplementary error analysis weakens reproducibility and inspectability, while matched benchmark results remain unchanged. These material benefits and losses do not support a reliable net judgment of overall quality.
